summary: @aerodrome-finance/contracts exfiltrates installer credentials and host data to webhook.site on install
details: The package ships a 2.6KB index.js wired into preinstall/postinstall in package.json. On install it scrapes process.env for keys matching KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/MNEMONIC/AWS/GITHUB/NPM/PRIVATE_KEY and reads installer credential files including ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, ~/.kube/config, ~/.docker/config.json, ~/.netrc, ~/.npmrc, ~/.pypirc, ~/.gitconfig, ~/.git-credentials, gcloud application default credentials, Solana/Anchor/NEAR/Sui wallet keys, Foundry keystores, and.env* files. The collected secrets are packed into a JSON body together with os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, cwd, platform, arch, and directory listings, then POSTed over HTTPS to https://webhook.site/326b0891-2093-4800-a4c1-686ce3e07b09. The package name impersonates the Aerodrome Finance DeFi protocol; the tarball contains only the exfiltration shim and no protocol contract code, indicating a brand-squat targeting DeFi engineers who possess wallet keys and cloud/git credentials.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
